ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

Strategy Insights and Planning Associate Consultant

As an Associate Consultant within Discovery Strategy & Transformation, you’ll help biotech and life sciences organizations solve complex challenges at the intersection of science, business, technology, and change. You’ll work with research and discovery teams on initiatives such as AI adoption, process reimagination, transformation orchestration, change enablement, and value realization.

This role is ideal for someone who understands how scientific organizations operate and can translate technical or research-driven challenges into structured business problems, practical recommendations, and measurable impact.

What You’ll Do


Support strategy and transformation engagements across biotech and life sciences research organizations.
Help clients adopt new technologies, including AI, by defining change strategies, user needs, value drivers, and impact metrics.
Apply design thinking, lean principles, and structured problem solving to ambiguous business and operational challenges.
Reimagine processes and decision-making approaches to improve efficiency, adoption, and business outcomes.
Develop analyses, recommendations, and client-ready presentations for scientific, business, and technology stakeholders.
Facilitate discussions and workshops that help organizations align on priorities, operating models, and transformation plans.


What You’ll Bring


At least 2.5 years of relevant experience across consulting, life sciences, strategy, transformation, or business advisory.
Life sciences or biotech experience is required, ideally with exposure to research, discovery, wet lab, dry lab, bioinformatics, computational biology, or scientific R&D environments.
Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in biology, bioinformatics, life sciences, engineering, or a related scientific field.
Experience with one or more of the following: change management, change enablement, design thinking, lean/process improvement, corporate strategy, technology transformation, or AI adoption.
Strong structured problem-solving, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to connect scientific and technical topics to broader business objectives, value creation, and ROI.
Fluency in English
Client-first mentality
Intense work ethic
Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach


How you’ll grow:


Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions


Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States, visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

Work Authorization:

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States that does not now or in the future require employer sponsorship.

To complete your application:

An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

Vital Strategy Group is a life sciences strategy consulting firm built on science, driven by insight, and focused on impact. Our mission is to help biopharma companies make confident, data-driven decisions that accelerate the delivery of innovative therapies to patients.




Vital is seeking Associates to join our growing team in Summer/Fall 2027 and contribute to high-impact life sciences strategy engagements. Associates will work across all stages of client engagements, from research and analysis through the development of strategic recommendations and client-ready deliverables. As a member of a small, founder-led team, you will work directly with firm leadership, take on meaningful responsibility early, and help shape the future of the firm as it grows.




Key Responsibilities

Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to support strategic client engagements.
Analyze market, client, and industry data to identify key insights and strategic implications.
Develop market assessments, competitive landscapes, market models, and other strategic analyses.
Support primary market research, including development of interview guides, participation in interviews, and synthesis of findings.
Translate research and analysis into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
Develop high-quality, client-ready presentations and other deliverables.
Collaborate closely with case teams and contribute to client discussions and presentations.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in science, business, engineering, or a related field, with graduation expected in 2027.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.
Attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and ability to learn quickly and take on increasing responsibility.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Demonstrated interest in life sciences and strategy consulting.




Benefits

Comprehensive benefits and total rewards package
Direct mentorship and collaboration with experienced consulting leaders.
Meaningful responsibility and opportunities for rapid professional growth.
Opportunity to help build Vital Strategy Group and shape its culture.




This role will follow a hybrid working model, with regular in-person work from our Boston or New York office. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.




The anticipated base salary range for this position is $75,000-$90,000. This role is also eligible for an annual performance bonus.




Vital Strategy Group is an equal opportunity employer. Company Description

L.E.K. is a premier strategy consulting firm, known for its fast pace, high-impact work, and close-knit international team. If you are smart, humble, and eager to tackle some of the toughest and most interesting business problems, we invite you to consider joining L.E.K.

Founded in 1983, L.E.K. employs more than 2,200 professionals across five continents, and is consistently recognized as one of the industry’s best firms to work for. For more information, visit lek.com.

The Digital practice helps our clients solve their most pressing challenges with digital & AI solutions. Given the vast opportunity provided by the confluence of disruptive technologies, the pace of change, and evolving needs of consumers and talent companies face new decisions on the future of their business. We define and design our clients’ future businesses and the markets in which they participate.

Job Description

If you are a bright, motivated professional looking to tackle some of the toughest and most interesting business problems at the intersection of strategy, digital & AI, consider joining L.E.K.’s Digital practice as an Associate Consultant.

Responsibilities

Associate Consultants drive our insights for clients. You will quickly take on significant responsibilities as you play a crucial role on each case team, gathering, analyzing, and synthesizing research and data to address the client’s core issues. Your ability to uncover novel information, conduct rigorous analysis, solve problems creatively, and communicate your high-quality work is critical to the breakthroughs that make a lasting impact for our clients. Associate Consultants at L.E.K. manage workstreams right from the start. While casework varies every day, Associate Consultants’ primary responsibilities typically include:


Framing ambiguous client problems and designing the analytical or technical approach to solve them
Researching and synthesizing — running primary and secondary research and converting findings into actionable recommendations and strategic narratives
Prototyping and deploying digital and AI solutions — including agents, data products, evaluation harnesses, and lightweight internal tools — that move clients from strategy to execution
Choosing deliberately when a question is best answered with a deck, a working prototype, or both — and being able to deliver either
Owning workstreams end-to-end, from problem definition through client-ready output, with accountability for both quality and pace
Embedding with clients in the field, iterating solutions with end users, and driving adoption alongside the strategy
Coaching junior team members across analytical and technical work, building capability across the case team
Communicating findings — written, verbal, and demonstrable — with the clarity and conviction expected of a senior client advisor


At L.E.K., we offer a fast-paced experience with a multitude of learning opportunities, accelerated growth, and a variety of career paths. Here, your colleagues will help shape your success as you learn, grow, and contribute to others' success.

L.E.K. recruits the best and the brightest, then offers them the broadest range of high-impact, frequent, and diverse cases for maximum learning. We are also committed to investing in your training and development and providing excellent analytical and leadership skills for your progression in tenure.

In addition to very competitive compensation and benefits, we promote Associate Consultants to Consultants and beyond, based on demonstrated performance.

Click here for more on the Associate experience at L.E.K.

WHY L.E.K.?

The Associate Consultant role within L.E.K.’s Digital practice is differentiated from other firms in several key ways:


A hybrid mandate, strategic framing and hands-on build, not one or the other
Meaningful management opportunities
Breadth of experiences – both in terms of digital & AI topics as well as industry sectors
Fun, stimulating work environment
International exposure
Upward mobility and meritocratic culture


Qualifications And Experience Needed


Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier institution with a record of academic excellence
3–4 years of full-time, post-undergraduate professional experience in strategy consulting, digital / AI product roles, software or data engineering, or a similar mixed environment
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and structure ambiguous problems
Hands-on proficiency with modern AI tooling including agent frameworks, prompt design, evals, retrieval-augmented systems and working fluency in at least one production-grade language (Python preferred)
Fluency with the contemporary data and AI architecture stack, modern data warehouses, vector stores, orchestration frameworks, and the broader vendor landscape and the judgment to navigate buy-vs-build choices
Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication, equally credible presenting to a CIO and demoing working software to its end users
The judgment to know when a problem is better answered with strategic framing than with code, and vice versa and the range to deliver either
Proven leadership and initiative; comfort embedding with clients in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
Ability to integrate digital and AI thinking into traditional strategy casework and contribute to the growth of the Digital practice


Strategy consulting experience (e.g., digital practices at strategy firms) is advantageous; strong candidates from product, engineering, AI-native consultancies, or corporate digital roles will be considered if they demonstrate consulting readiness

Additional Information


L.E.K. Consulting offers a competitive salary and benefits package commensurate with experience. The base salary at the Associate Consultant level is $135,000USD. The estimated total potential compensation at this level is up to $200,000USD.
L.E.K. Consulting offers a competitive total rewards package including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with employer contribution, HSA contributions (where applicable), paid time off, and other firm-sponsored benefits. 
This role follows our hybrid work model for U.S. offices.  We require employees to be in their assigned home office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday each week, as well as the first Friday of each month. 
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without the need for employer sponsorship. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider candidates requiring sponsorship for visas, including but not limited to TN, H1-B, F-1, STEM OPT/CPT, or any other work authorization.
L.E.K. Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. 
In accordance with applicable state and local laws, we will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs, practices, or observances.

Gabrielle Arcand
Gabrielle Arcand
Recruiting Business Consultants in Boston

We are looking for recent graduates and early career professionals to join our award-winning management consultancy based in Boston!




Do you have a passion for problem-solving?




Do you want to join a collaborative team with motivated people who will mentor you to be the best you can possibly be?




Do you want to join a dynamic and fast-growing firm in the US, looking for people to help build our US presence?




At Clarasys, we know we’re a fun and sociable company to work for because we have the awards to prove it. In the UK, our consistently high ranking in the top 100 Best Companies is partly down to our strong, supportive culture, training program, and the responsibility and trust we put in our people right from the start. This award-winning culture translates directly into our US team. See Case Studies of our work, here.




What do we do?

Clarasys is a fast-growing, independent management consultancy. We specialize in business analysis, change, digital transformation, customer experience and agile methodologies to deliver sustainable improvements. Based in Boston and London UK, Clarasys exists to make a lasting difference to the way people work, live, and grow.




For our clients (big and small, across a variety of sectors) that means collaborating with them to fix complex problems and improve their customers’ experience. We measure our success on client satisfaction.




For our people that means working in a company that is principled and does the right thing. We create opportunities that enable people to be at their best in a team-orientated, supportive environment.




For the world that means contributing to our community through pro bono work.




Our Associate Consultant (AC) Scheme:

The training: We’ll set you up to be a great consultant during four weeks of interactive training based at our home office, London, UK. This training will be focused on all of the consulting skills you will need. This will include organized lunches and socials, you will get to know our team here at Clarasys as well as each other.




Early weeks: In weeks 5 & 6, you will return to the Boston office and you’ll be putting those skills into practice by looking at, and delivering on, specific ways we can make Clarasys even better. Our non-hierarchical and collaborative culture means you’ll work with people of all seniority across the business.




Delivering a pro bono project: During weeks 6-12, you’ll have the opportunity to deliver a real project for a charity. Previous clients have included The Prince’s Trust, Northeast Arc, and Marie Curie Cancer Care. Whilst you’ll have an experienced consultant with you for support, you’ll be planning and delivering the work - taking responsibility early on.




Working with clients: From week 13 onwards, you will be involved in delivering client-facing work. With continuous support from us (including meeting your coach once a week and further training), you will rapidly develop your skills and grow into a capable and talented consultant.




Our ideal candidates will:

Have a stellar academic record so they can grapple with the intellectual complexity of consulting projects.
Be problem solvers and enjoy the challenge of taking on a problem and having the responsibility for solving it.
Be analytical in the way they tackle issues by using data and information to understand and fix them.
Have strong communication skills so they can build trust and solve clients’ problems.
Be proactive and inquisitive and be able to take responsibility for making things happen. Successful candidates will also have a willingness to learn and grasp new skills and concepts.
Value team over individual and always believe that multiple brains will be more effective. As a team player, you will enjoy and thrive on working in a collaborative environment.
Be confident in handling difficult or unexpected situations in order to manage the ambiguity and changing environment of consulting projects.
Be interested in developing project management, business analytics, data analytics, and change management skills to round out your consulting skill set.
Apply own judgement when using AI




Key Dates:

Virtual Group Assessment Day: December 2nd, 2026
Start Date: February 1st, 2027




You must be able to make both dates to be considered for this program. Initial phone interviewing will start in October and continue through November for qualified applicants.




Application Process, if you are successful:

Apply online, through our external partner Yonder
Complete the eligibility form, take the psychometric assessment, and submit a CV
30 minute Telephone Interview
Assessment Day conducted online with Clarasys staff where you'll group interview with other candidates, meet team members in both offices, and get a chance to see more of the work that we do




Why work for us?

Top tier health insurance, we pay employee premiums
Competitive salary
25 days base vacation time, with option to buy or sell up to 5 days per calendar year.
20 Days of sick time
7 set paid holidays
Pro bono days during the year which employees can use to ‘give back’ to the community, whether that’s using their consulting expertise to help at a charity of choice!
Career coach and a learning & development allowance that can go towards external exams
Peer reward scheme
Access to our performance psychologist
Company laptop and cell phone allowance
4% 401k match
Named one of the “Best Places to Work in the UK” 2026 by The Sunday Times
Named one of the UK’s leading management consultancies by the Financial Times for the sixth consecutive year (2026)
Opt into our dental and eye care plans
Inclusive employee socials; variety of board game nights, trying new restaurants, and exploring the city




If you are currently located outside the Greater Boston Area, we are accepting applications, however, if you accept an offer, you must have relocated within commuting distance to the Boston Office by February 1st, 2027




If you are interested in Clarasys and believe you would be a suitable candidate, please apply now!




**Please note that when applying you will be directed to a third-party platform called Yonder where you will be asked to create an application, submit your resume and take psychometric tests (this can be done in your own time and takes approximately 30 minutes). You will need stable internet access, a PC or Laptop with audio/sound, an up-to-date browser (Chrome or Firefox recommended) to complete the assessments.**




Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must not require now or in the future sponsorship for employment visa status.




At Clarasys, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion is not, and never has been a tick-box exercise. We consider it a golden thread woven into each thought, word and action.




When you apply to this role, we will retain your CV and related Personal Data on file for up to 1 year for the purposes outlined in our privacy policy, which is available on our website. You may withdraw your consent at any time and/or exercise any of your other rights under our privacy policy by contacting recruitmentteam@clarasys.com.

This range is provided by Zifo. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range
$110,000.00/yr - $125,000.00/yr

About Zifo{{:}} 

Zifo is a global scientific and technical consulting partner specializing in strategy, informatics, and innovation for clients in life sciences organizations, such as pharmaceutical R&D, biotechnology, and agritech. We help organizations accelerate discovery, optimize development pipelines, and leverage data to achieve measurable impact.   

Position Overview{{:}} 

The Associate Scientific Strategy Consultant sits within the North American consulting group wherein key accountabilities include driving project elucidation, stakeholder management and defining & driving project success in partnership with internal and external stakeholders. The successful candidate will lead medium-to-high complexity consulting engagements for multiple customers. This role blends scientific expertise, industry knowledge, and informatics/data skills with leadership and collaboration to deliver high-quality solutions. You will work closely with senior consultants, client stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to ensure project success, drive operational excellence, and contribute to business development. 

Key Responsibilities{{:}} 

Consulting & Scientific Strategy 

Engage as a leader to define and own project success, leveraging core consulting behaviours such as active listening, empathetic collaboration, strong sense of ownership and effective communication across multiple audiences 
Own accountability for business analysis deliverables including user requirements specifications (URS), functional requirements specifications, data & process maps, workflows, gap analyses, implementation roadmaps, evaluation methodologies, and questionnaires. 
Conduct vendor evaluations and define implementation strategies to enable effective decision-making by pharma/biotech/agritech clients. 
Assess system landscapes and contribute to IT, informatics and data landscape roadmaps. 

Project Execution & Leadership 

Manage one or more large projects/programs, including estimation, scheduling, risk management, and milestone tracking. 
Facilitate project meetings, communicate status updates, and escalate risks when necessary. 
Mentor associates across Zifo, guiding their project engagements and professional development. 
Track and monitor key project metrics to ensure the success of client engagements as well as adherence to operational components of project delivery. 

Customer Engagement & Collaboration 

Serve as primary point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders, managing expectations on process, quality, schedule, and delivery - all with an overall view of what qualifies as successful engagement 
Build rapport with client managers and support and/or drive strategic customer meetings. 
Identify opportunities for additional value creation within client organizations and internal process improvements. 

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement 

Plan and track billable effort, manage utilization and productivity of themselves and teams, and support budget forecasting. 
Manage escalations, identify & track risks to project execution, initiate corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and drive continuous improvement initiatives. 
Support internal training programs, and mentor team members in emerging areas. 

Business Development & Thought Leadership 

Assist in proposals related to emerging opportunities with clients and supporting RFP responses. 
Contribute to case studies, presentations, and white papers. 
Attend industry conferences for learning, networking, and representing Zifo. 

Learning, Mentorship & Continuous Improvement 

Demonstrate continuous learning in scientific domains, informatics systems and data strategies, change management and strategic consulting methodologies. 
Identify needs and drive efforts for internal development and knowledge-sharing initiatives. 
Mentor other analysts across business units within Zifo, fostering collaboration career development. 


Requirements



Qualifications{{:}} 

Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant scientific discipline such as biology, chemistry, chem/bioinformatics among others (Master's preferred) 
5-7 years of relevant industry experience in pharmaceutical R&D, biotechnology, or agritech. 
Experience leading informatics solution projects (e.g., ELN, LIMS implementations) 
Familiarity with scientific workflows (e.g., bioanalysis, compound management, medicinal chemistry)and key data concepts within the life sciences industry and relevance to operational activities and enabling decision-making. 
Strong communication skills and ability to drive problem elucidation activities, influence internal and external stakeholders and convey technical concepts to diverse audiences. 
Proven ability to work collaboratively in multi-disciplinary teams as well as manage project deliverables and stakeholder expectations. 

Desired Attributes{{:}} 

Proactive problem-solving and adaptability in fast-paced environments. 
Interest in further developing leadership capabilities and taking ownership of project outcomes. 
Able to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity on problem statements and potential solutions. 

Travel expectations{{:}} 

Travel (up to 25%) to client sites and for internal meetings as needed. 


Benefits



CURIOSITY DRIVEN, SCIENCE FOCUSED, EMPLOYEE BUILT. Our culture is unlike any other, one where we debate, challenge ourselves, and interact with all alike. We are a curious bunch, characterized by our passion to learn and spirit of teamwork. Zifo is a global R&D solutions provider focused on the industries of Pharma, Biotech, Manufacturing QC, Medical Devices, specialty chemicals and other research-based organizations. Our team's knowledge of science and expertise in technology help Zifo better serve our customers around the globe, including 18 of the Top 20 Biopharma companies. 

We look for Science - Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Technology, Biomedical Engineering, Microbiology etc. We possess scientific and technical knowledge and bear professional and personal goals.  While we have a "no doors" policy to promote free access within, we do have a tough door to walk in. We search with a two-point agenda - technical competency and cultural adaptability. 

We offer a competitive compensation package including accrued vacation, medical, dental, vision, 401k with company matching, life insurance, and flexible spending accounts.  

If you share these sentiments and are prepared for the atypical, then Zifo is your calling! 

Zifo is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

The Opportunity

As part of the AI Engineering team within the Digital Assurance & Technology team, you will leverage advanced technologies and techniques to design and develop robust data solutions for clients. Within our Assurance practice, you will transform raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Your role will involve designing AI systems, data wrangling, and software implementation to enable AI models to be useful and scalable. You will support workstreams involving testing and evaluation of AI-enabled systems, analyze technical evidence and control effectiveness, and develop reusable tools that support responsible, reliable AI deployment.

As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to client engagement and projects while developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will be exposed to clients to learn how to build meaningful client connections, manage and inspire others, and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge of firm services and technology resources.

You will be expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, embrace ambiguity, ask questions, and use these challenges as opportunities for growth.

In this role, you will apply a learning mindset, take ownership of your development, and consistently deliver quality work that drives value for our clients and success as a team.

Responsibilities


Designing and implementing AI systems to transform raw data into actionable insights
Developing and deploying machine learning models to support client decision-making
Collaborating with team members to integrate AI solutions into existing data infrastructure
Conducting complex data analysis to identify patterns and trends
Utilizing programming languages such as Python to build scalable AI applications
Applying data modeling techniques to enhance data quality and integration
Engaging in data wrangling and preprocessing to prepare datasets for analysis
Building and maintaining relational database management systems for efficient data storage
Supporting client engagements by providing technical insights and recommendations
Continuously learning and adapting to new AI technologies and methodologies
Supporting the design and execution of tests for AI-system behavior, performance, robustness, bias, explainability, and failure modes
Evaluating technical controls and evidence and clearly documenting findings, limitations, and recommendations
Developing reusable evaluation tools, automated tests, reference datasets, monitoring capabilities, and evidence workflows


What You Must Have


At least a Bachelor's degree

About Cedar Gate Technologies

Cedar Gate Technologies, an IQVIA business, enables payers, providers, employers, and service administrators to excel at value-based care with a unified technology and services platform delivering analytics, care, and payment technology on a single data management foundation. At Cedar Gate, you’ll be part of a collaborative, innovative environment where great ideas thrive. We invest deeply in our people through ongoing training, comprehensive benefits, and a strong culture of teamwork, offering the chance to grow your skills while contributing to high impact initiatives for some of the world's most dynamic companies.

Position Summary

At Cedar Gate Technologies, an IQVIA business, the Senior Data Analytics Analyst will collaborate closely with Data Managers to analyze complex healthcare data, design scalable data solutions, and support the integration of client data into the Cedar Gate Analytics Platform. This role leverages a variety of analytic, statistical, and ETL tools to ensure accurate, efficient, and standardized data processing across multiple healthcare sources. In this role, you’ll play a critical part in transforming data into meaningful insights that improve healthcare outcomes, while growing your technical expertise within a supportive, innovation‑focused team.

This role assumes prior, hands-on experience working with complex healthcare claims datasets and does not include foundational training.

Roles & Responsibilities


Interpret, analyze, and validate data using advanced statistical, querying, and analytical techniques.
Perform data cleansing, transformation, and aggregation from diverse healthcare data sources.
Map disparate data fields into a unified schema and reconcile our client’s member information across datasets.
Support data standardization efforts, including relationship code alignment, demographic normalization, member month calculations, and healthcare code analysis.
Execute detailed data analysis tasks assigned by the reporting manager in support of client and internal goals.
Follow organizational data processing standards using proprietary tools and ETL pipelines for Analytics.
Partner with Data Managers and cross functional teams, including Client Success and Client Delivery, to gather requirements, document workflows, analyze use cases, and support implementation activities.
Troubleshoot and resolve client technical issues related to healthcare claims, EMR data, and ancillary data sources; provide timely ad hoc support during scheduled and unscheduled client interactions.


Experience / Qualifications


This position requires working in the office in Burlington, MA, at least 3 days per week (4 days per week preferred) to work alongside other data team members.

Who We Are

Point32Health is a leading not-for-profit health and well-being organization dedicated to delivering high-quality, affordable healthcare. Serving nearly 2 million members, Point32Health builds on the legacy of Harvard Pilgrim Health Care and Tufts Health Plan to provide access to care and empower healthier lives for everyone. Our culture revolves around being a community of care and having shared values that guide our behaviors and decisions. We’ve had a long-standing commitment to inclusion and equal healthcare access and outcomes, regardless of background; it’s at the core of who we are. We value the rich mix of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all of our colleagues, which helps us to provide service with empathy and better understand and meet the needs of the communities where we serve, live, and work.

We enjoy the important work we do every day in service to our members, partners, colleagues and communities. Learn more about who we are at Point32Health.

Job Summary

Point32Health is elevating the way it drives Medicare Star Ratings, moving from reporting on performance to strategically shaping it. Reporting to the Director, Medicare Star Strategy and partnering closely with Enterprise Clinical Strategy and Stars & Quality leadership, the Stars Strategy Consultant is a strategic doer who can turn Star performance data into insight, sizes and pressure-tests improvement opportunities, and builds the analytics, models, and materials that move the most promising ideas from insight to action across all Medicare Advantage contracts. This role blends rigorous Stars analytics with a strategy consulting toolkit and is ideal for a high-performing analyst or associate from a top-tier strategy consulting firm who wants to apply structured problem-solving to one of the most important quality and affordability challenges in health care.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities/Duties – what you will be doing:


Stars analytics & reporting: Execute timely and accurate data sourcing, validation, analytics, and reporting across Medicare Advantage contracts, including monthly Star performance and member-level data, annual survey data, and CMS data, producing insightful and actionable reports, dashboards, and member-level views.
Performance monitoring & root-cause analysis: Monitor and evaluate current and anticipated Part C and Part D measure trends and conduct structured root-cause analysis for measures trending low, cutting across geographies, markets, and provider groups to pinpoint the drivers behind performance gaps.
Problem framing & opportunity sizing: Break down ambiguous performance questions into structured, solvable problems; develop hypotheses and issue trees, and build quantitative models to size and pressure-test improvement opportunities, clearly stating assumptions, sensitivities, and confidence behind each estimate.
Solution development & benchmarking: Research and compare potential interventions, benchmark external approaches, and assemble the analytic and business case that helps leadership prioritize the highest-value paths to sustainable 4+ Star achievement, including the rising weight of pharmacy and CAHPS-driven measures.
Data correlation & insight: Identify and analyze correlations across data sources, including Member and Provider Satisfaction data, HEDIS, CAHPS, HOS, and operational metrics, to enable comprehensive, well-supported business decisions.
Initiative execution support: Help drive prioritized opportunities from concept toward well-formed initiatives that create measurable value in Star ratings and total cost of care, tracking milestones, dependencies, and impact.
Executive-ready communication: Translate complex analysis into clear, compelling storylines, slides, and briefs, and prepare or support written reports and oral presentations of findings to internal and external stakeholders, distilling large amounts of information into a few decision-ready insights.
Tools, documentation & governance: Build dashboards and visualizations in platforms such as Power BI or Tableau, and develop and maintain policies, procedures, documentation, and folder management for all Star-related data analysis, query and report building, and presentation, establishing repeatable templates that make the capability durable.
Cross-functional partnership: Provide analytical and consultative support to a broad spectrum of internal business areas and measure owners, and participate in teams, meetings, and workgroups that require Star expertise, converting insight into prioritized, sized improvement opportunities.


Skills & Competencies

Skills

The Consultant will be a fast learner and self-starter with a strong analytical mind-set, critical and organized thinking, and a collaborative attitude, who thrives in ambiguity and manages multiple workstreams at once. Additional skills and competencies include:


Analytical Rigor: Applies structured problem-solving and quantitative discipline to unstructured, incomplete information, producing analyses that are accurate, well-documented, and defensible under scrutiny.
Acts Strategically: Connects individual analyses to the broader Stars and enterprise clinical strategy, and is willing to challenge legacy assumptions and historical performance ceilings, treating them as hypotheses to be tested and reset rather than fixed limits.
Customer Focus: Keeps the ultimate impact on members and customers at the center of the work, and builds trust-based relationships with internal stakeholders whose data and input the analysis depends on.
Accountability: Takes ownership of assigned workstreams, delivers reliable, on-time output with attention to detail, and proactively flags risks, gaps, and opportunities.
Other duties and projects as assigned.


Preferred Qualifications

Qualifications – what you need to perform the job


Direct experience with Medicare Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS/HOS, or health plan quality programs, and familiarity with CMS Star measure methodology.
Exposure to health plan operations and value-based / total-cost-of-care models.


Certification and Licensure





Education


Bachelor’s degree required; advanced coursework or a graduate degree (MBA, MHA, MPH, or related) is a plus.


Experience


4+ years of experience at the analyst or associate level with a top-tier strategy consulting firm, or comparable corporate strategy, health plan, or healthcare analytics experience.


Skill Requirements


Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems, build quantitative models, and translate analysis into clear recommendations.
Strong proficiency in Excel/financial modeling and PowerPoint, with hands-on experience in data visualization platforms such as Power BI or Tableau.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to distill complex analysis into executive-ready materials.
Comfort working with large, complex data sets and drawing sound, well-caveated conclusions from them.


Working Conditions and Additional Requirements (include special requirements, e.g., lifting, travel):


Must be able to work under normal office conditions and work from home as required.
Work may require simultaneous use of a telephone/headset and PC/keyboard and sitting for extended durations.
May be required to work additional hours beyond standard work schedule.
Anything specific to physical needs (lifting etc.)



The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Management retains the discretion to add to or change the duties of the position at any time.

Salary Range

$102,377.60 -$153,566.40

Compensation & Total Rewards Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position represents a range of salaries for this role and similar roles across the organization. The actual salary for this position will be determined by several factors, including the scope and complexity of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials, and experience of the candidate; as well as internal equity. As part of our comprehensive total rewards program, colleagues are also eligible for variable pay. Eligibility for any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits remains in the Company's sole discretion and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

Medical, dental and vision coverage

Tuition program

Full suite of benefits to support career development, individual & family health, and financial health

Introduction

At IBM Research, we are the innovation engine of IBM. Exploring what’s next in computing and shaping the technologies the world will rely on tomorrow. From advancing AI and hybrid cloud to pioneering practical quantum computing, we anticipate challenges and unlock new opportunities for clients, partners, and society. Working in Research means joining a team that accelerates discovery at the intersection of high-performance computing, AI, quantum, and cloud. You’ll collaborate with leading scientists, engineers, and visionaries to push boundaries and turn ideas into reality. With a culture built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration, IBM Research offers the opportunity to grow your career while contributing to breakthroughs that transform industries and change the world.

Your Role And Responsibilities

Within IBM Quantum, the Adoption Team is an elite team serving our partners as they research quantum computing solutions for their most pressing business challenges. We keep our partners up to date with the latest technical advances, and make sure they are empowered to use our software and services. As a data scientist intern, you will be supporting our data and analytics mission to drive reporting on and insights into the IBM Quantum partners and community members and your work will enable the team to make data-driven decisions. Focus areas will include adoption and impact of IBM Quantum hardware, software, learning and outreach content, and events. As a data scientist intern, your key stakeholders will be client/community-facing teams at IBM Quantum. In addition, you will interface across many individuals and parties at partner institutions and within IBM, including technical teams within IBM Quantum, product, marketing, and business development teams. You will support end-to-end workstreams, such as the building of new analytics resources and performing of advanced (predictive) data analysis. Successful attributes to thrive in this role are: Creative in framing and solving complex problems Self-starter Agile in navigating a complex organization and in stakeholder management Organized, with exceptional project management skills Quick learner with an independent growth mindset Able to absorb new technical concepts quickly and thoroughly Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly Enthusiasm about quantum computing and data science.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise


Pursuing a masters or PhD degree in data science or other quantitative field such as mathematics, computer science, statistics or physics.
Proficiency with SQL and experience working with relational databases.
Proficiency with Python and libraries commonly used for data analysis (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, matplotlib, Seaborn, etc.).
Knowledge of common machine learning algorithms and frameworks: linear regression, decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting (e.g., XGBoost, LightGBM), neural networks, and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch Experience building dashboards with one or more data visualization tools (experience with Metabase and/or Amplitude a plus)


Preferred Technical And Professional Experience


Experience with Github or other version control platform(s).
Demonstrated ability to communicate project insights and findings and propose actionable next steps.

Job Description

Kickstart Your Career at Vertex! 

Are you ready to make a real impact? At Vertex, our mission is to tackle serious diseases and to change lives, for the better, for the future. Our aim is to give you the skills, insights, and career guidance to be an important part of that future; to turn your potential into progression. As a Vertex intern or co-op, you’ll work on meaningful projects, collaborate with talented teams, and learn from industry leaders. We’re passionate about innovation, inclusion, and supporting your growth—inside and outside the lab. 

Why Vertex? 


Real Projects: You’ll work on assignments that make a real impact, not just busy work. 
Mentorship & Networking: Connect with leaders and peers who want to see you succeed through professional networks, connections, and collaborations that will shape your longer-term career. 
Flexible & Supportive: We offer flexible work options with Flex @ Vertex and prioritize your wellbeing. 
Inclusive Culture: Collaboration and inclusion are embedded in everything we do. 
Career Launchpad: Build skills, explore career paths, and get guidance for your future career. 


Your Impact

The Vertex Process Engineering Data Analytics Co-Op is a 6-month experiential training program for students currently working towards an advanced degree in Chemical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or other related fields. If you are passionate, collaborative, and growth-minded, a co-op at Vertex will help you gain meaningful experience in our Technical Operations - Drug Product functional areas and serve as a launchpad for your career.

The application deadline for this co-op is November 15th. Please note that Vertex reviews applications on a rolling basis and reserves the right to close this job posting prior to the listed deadline. Applicants can expect to receive an update about their application before or shortly after the application deadline.

Ready to apply? Submit your application and let’s turn possibilities into reality! 

 What you will be doing: 

The Vertex Technical Operations-Drug Product team is looking for a motivated Co-op to join our team this spring. The Co-op will be responsible for assessing historical manufacturing/process data to identify trends and identify oppurtunities to improve the process. The Co-op will have the opportunity to interact with multiple departments (Drug Product Operations, Quality Operations and Analytical Development), as well as work with talented people from different cultures and backgrounds.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze historical manufacturing/process data to identify trends, patterns, variability and potential process drivers-
Perform data cleaning, visualization and statistical analysis using tools such as JMP, Excel or Power BI
Develop meaningful visualizations and dashboards to communicate process performance and emerging trends
Partner with Manufacturing Science & Technology and Quality teams to translate data into actionable process insights.
Collaborate in a cross-functional team to develop solutions
Identify opportunities to improve process monitoring, data utilization and manufacturing performance.
Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Qualifications


Must be enrolled in a College/University and have at least finished one year of a Master’s or phD degree in Chemical Engineering or Biomedical Engineering with a strong background in statistics and data analytics.
Strong self-initiative, communication, and interpersonal and relationship skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an interest in manufacturing process data
Proficiency in statistical analysis and data visualization.
Proficiency in Excel; experience with JMP /Minitab is preferred.
Minimum 3.5 GPA
Legal authorization to work in the United States, now and in the future. Please note that Vertex does not provide sponsorship for internships/co-ops or entry level roles within this part of the organization.
You must be enrolled in an advanced degree program if graduating before May 2027
You must be available to work full-time, 40 hours per week from January – July 2027


Program Details:  


Full-time, paid co-op $30.00 – 50.00 USD/hour 
Program Dates: January – July 2027 
Application Deadline: November 15th, 2026


At Vertex, we believe that when you feel your best, you can perform at your best. That’s why our US benefits and global well-being resources are designed to support you.


Free 24/7 onsite gym access and free access to group exercise classes 
Subsidized commuter benefits- transit and parking 
Provided meals—free breakfast daily! 
Career development opportunities and events, including C Suite engagement 
Social events—both intern-only and company-wide 
Location-specific perks and extras! 
Recognition of National Intern Day 


 

Our Ways of Working 

Flex Designation:  Hybrid - Boston

Flex Eligibility Status:  Hybrid: work three days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility. 

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.  

This job posting is for a temporary role with a third-party agency partner that provides services to Vertex.  The individual selected for this role will be offered the role as an employee of that third-party agency; compensation, medical benefits, fringe benefits and other terms and conditions of employment shall be presented by the third-party agency upon offer. 

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

Pay Range

$0 - $0

Disclosure Statement

The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.

Company Information

Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation.

Vertex is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Vertex is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. Vertex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact Talent Acquisition at ApplicationAssistance@vrtx.com

Withum is a place where talent thrives - where who you are matters. It’s a place of endless opportunities for growth. A place where entrepreneurial energy plus inclusive teamwork equals exponential results.

Explore different industries. Learn new skills. Connect with our diverse teams of professionals to gain insight into the career you envision. Your Career Starts with You.

Experience the Transformative Power of Withum Plus You - that’s the Power in the Plus!

Job Description

Withum's Valuation Consulting Services team assists companies with business valuations, M&A transactions, financial reporting, economic analysis, fairness opinions, risk management, and other strategic advisory services. As our advisory practice continues to expand, including new outsourced accounting and finance solutions, we are seeking high-performing students interested in valuation, corporate finance, and transaction advisory.

Internship Details

Dates: January 25th,2027 to April 16th, 2027 with possibility of extension

Location: Boston Seaport, Rochester or Philadelphia

Schedule: 40 hours per week, in-person. Interns are expected to work during core business hours.

Key Responsibilities


Assist in the preparation of business valuation analyses for mergers and acquisitions, financial reporting, tax, and advisory purposes.
Support valuation engagements involving privately held companies, intangible assets, and transaction-related analyses.
Complete financial statement and operating data analysis using Excel-based valuation models.
Conduct industry, market, economic, and company-specific research.
Assist with financial modeling, data analysis, and valuation assessments.
Participate in client meetings and internal discussions related to valuation and advisory engagements.
Collaborate with professionals across Valuation Consulting, Transaction Advisory, and Outsourced Accounting Advisory teams.
Prepare sections of valuation reports, presentations, and client deliverables.
Participate in training sessions, professional development programs, and networking opportunities.
Support business development initiatives and relationship-building activities.


Qualifications


Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Quantitative Finance, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Economics, Financial Engineering, Accounting, Business Analytics, or a related discipline. MSA, Master of Finance, MBA, and similar graduate programs are encouraged to apply.
Minimum 3.7 GPA required.
Previous internship or relevant experience in valuation, investment banking, transaction advisory, corporate finance, consulting, or financial services preferred.
Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Understanding of financial statements, valuation methodologies, and financial modeling.
Excellent communication, networking, and presentation skills with the ability to excel in client-facing environments.
Demonstrated leadership, initiative, and professional presence through academic, extracurricular, or work experience.
Candidates should be prepared to complete a finance and valuation case study during the interview process.


Why Withum?

Withum is a firm built on the principle that the only limits to your growth are the ones you set for yourself. Our culture is centered around an expansion mindset both in terms of the firm's growth and the personal development of every team member. At Withum, opportunities for advancement and success are directly tied to initiative, ambition, and contributions.

Interns are active contributors to client engagements and gain meaningful exposure to valuation, M&A, corporate finance, and advisory services while working alongside experienced professionals. If you're interested in building a career in valuation and transaction advisory, we encourage you to apply.

The compensation for this position ranges from $25 to $30 an hour. Final offer amounts are based on multiple factors such as the specific role, hiring location, as well as the individual’s skills, experience and qualifications. For additional information on our benefits, visit our website at https://www.withum.com/careers/.

Job Description

The Future Talent Program features internships that last 10-12 weeks and will include one or more projects. These opportunities can provide you with great development and a chance to see if we are the right company for your long-term goals.

The Biostatistics and Research Decision Sciences (BARDS) Epidemiology and RWE Capabilities & Analytics is seeking 2027 summer interns.

Primary responsibilities may include but are not limited to the following:


Summarizing background information of a specific topic via targeted literature review
Conducting data analysis in real-world health data sources to understand data quality, disease identification or treatment patterns, develop and validate prediction models
Summarizing and interpreting study results
Contributing to protocol development and manuscript writing
Contributing to development and update of visualization tools (e.g., dashboard, geospatial visuals) of real-world data
Contributing to development of materials to understand artificial intelligence and machine learning methods
Communicating findings to an internal or external audience


The interns will have the opportunity to present their research work in internal or external professional forums or meetings. In addition, the interns will attend departmental and project team meetings to gain a broad perspective on the application of epidemiology and statistical method in the pharmaceutical industry. We are seeking intern candidates with strong academic performance, communication skills, spirit of teamwork, and the ability to work in a multi-functional environment.

Locations: West Point, PA; Upper Gwynedd, PA; Rahway, NJ, Boston, MA

Minimum Education Requirements


Candidates must be a currently enrolled graduate student pursuing a PhD degree in epidemiology, biostatistics, public health, data science, biomedical informatics, or other closely related field; Or a currently enrolled graduate student pursuing a PharmD degree with relevant training in epidemiology
Candidates will have completed at least 2 semesters of graduate work towards a PhD degree in epidemiology, biostatistics, public health, data Science, biomedical Informatics, or other closely related field by May 30, 2027; or towards a PharmD degree with relevant training in epidemiology by May 30, 2027.


Required Experience And Skills


Candidates must be able to commit to full-time employment for 10 - 12 weeks beginning in May or June 2027.
Candidates must be scheduled to return to school in Fall 2027, unless the internship is a requirement for their degree.
Candidates must have effective oral and written communication skills.


Preferred Experience And Skills


Candidates should have prior literature review (systematic/target) experience, have a good understanding of real-world data and real-world databases and have a good knowledge of SAS, SQL, R, or Python.
Students with an interest in genetics/biomarkers, geospatial analysis, policy, or patient-reported outcomes/clinical outcomes assessments (PROs/COAs), data science, model development, artificial intelligence/machine learning are encouraged to apply.


Please note that this position may be closed before the posted end date or may remain open longer, at the discretion of the company.

Collaborate within an innovative lab environment—balancing focused coding sessions with active participation in ideation and product design.

Job Title: 2027 Spring Co-op Data Science & Digital Transformation


Grade: Co-op

About The Job

Looking to launch your career at the cutting edge of healthcare? Join Sanofi for a chance to develop with mentoring and guidance from inspirational leaders while helping to make an impact on the lives of countless people worldwide. We are seeking a highly motivated Spring Co-op to join our Data Science & Digital Transformation team.

MSAT Process Data Science & Digital Transformation (MSAT DSD) is a transversal team within the Global MSAT organization. MSAT DSD is the data/digital DNA within the processes allowing us to ensure best in class manufacturing & analytical processes, especially by focusing on data/digital innovations & excellence, aiming to guarantee acceleration and securing launches & improvement as well as sustainability for our current processes.

The Co-op position is in DSD Process Modeling & Control group. The group develops and implements advanced process modeling and technologies (e.g. Digital twins, PAT) to enable Sanofi to better understand, monitor, and control the manufacturing operations, and deliver innovative, robust, and cost-effective next-generation processes. The group is highly cross functional in its interactions across R&D and manufacturing, and provides scientific, technical, process engineering expertise to these organizations.

Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams.

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities


Contribute to the evaluation and development of hybrid modeling techniques to improve understanding of cell culture processes
Use simulations and process data to identify atypical results
Test capabilities of simulation platform and user interface for application to a new use case
Work as part of a team, engaging with other scientists and engineers with complementary skill sets
Generate documents (presentations, user guides, reports) related to learnings and achievements


About You

Basic Qualifications:


Currently enrolled at an accredited college or university pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Chemical Engineering, Biological Engineering, Biochemistry, Computer Science, or a related field.
Must be permanently authorized to work in the U.S. and not require sponsorship of an employment visa (e.g., H-1B or green card) at the time of application or in the future. Students currently on CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT usually require future sponsorship for long term employment and do not meet the Internal requirements for this program unless eligible for an alternative long-term status that does not require company sponsorship.
Must be enrolled in an accredited college or university throughout the duration of the co-op/internship.
Must be able to relocate to the office location and work 40hrs/week, Monday to Friday for the full duration of the co-op/internship.


Preferred Qualifications


Knowledge of computer programming concepts (Python preferred)
Understanding of basic chemical reaction mechanisms and empirical equations.
Understanding of basic concepts of cell growth and metabolism
Experience with scientific literature search.
Experience with mechanistic, statistical, and/or machine learning techniques preferred.


Why Choose Us


Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future focused team.
Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you.
Learn from inspiring mentors and collaborative teams while contributing to real projects that shape the future of healthcare.
Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve.


Compensation

The salary range for this position is $35 -$57 USD hourly. All compensation will be determined commensurate with demonstrated experience.

Job Description

Kickstart Your Career at Vertex! 

Are you ready to make a real impact? At Vertex, our mission is to tackle serious diseases and to change lives, for the better, for the future. Our aim is to give you the skills, insights, and career guidance to be an important part of that future; to turn your potential into progression. As a Vertex intern or co-op, you’ll work on meaningful projects, collaborate with talented teams, and learn from industry leaders. We’re passionate about innovation, inclusion, and supporting your growth—inside and outside the lab. 

Why Vertex? 


Real Projects: You’ll work on assignments that make a real impact, not just busy work. 
Mentorship & Networking: Connect with leaders and peers who want to see you succeed through professional networks, connections, and collaborations that will shape your longer-term career. 
Flexible & Supportive: We offer flexible work options with Flex @ Vertex and prioritize your wellbeing. 
Inclusive Culture: Collaboration and inclusion are embedded in everything we do. 
Career Launchpad: Build skills, explore career paths, and get guidance for your future career. 


Your Impact

The Vertex Commercial Analytics, Market Access Co-Op is a 6-month experiential training program for students currently working towards an undergraduate or advanced degree in Engineering, Statistics, Analytics, STEM, or other related fields. If you are passionate, collaborative, and growth-minded, a co-op at Vertex will help you gain meaningful experience in our US Market Access functional areas and serve as a launchpad for your career.

The application deadline for this co-op is November 15th. Please note that Vertex reviews applications on a rolling basis and reserves the right to close this job posting prior to the listed deadline. Applicants can expect to receive an update about their application before or shortly after the application deadline.

Ready to apply? Submit your application and let’s turn possibilities into reality! 

 What you will be doing: 

US Market Access analytics team functions as an analytics center of excellence for the market access strategy, trade & distribution, revenue forecasting and pricing teams. The analytics team supports use cases that help the different commercial business units ensure that patients with a script for Vertex products have access to the products through their health plans, pharmacies and sites-of-care.

The co-op commercial analytics will work with the US market access analytics team to work on forecasting and regression use cases that can help identify key drivers and barriers towards patient access for our pain and cystic fibrosis portfolio.

Key Responsibilities


The co-op commercial analytics will work on several small initiatives each with a timeline of 3-4 weeks, the initial few weeks will be spent in training around US pharma and market access dynamics. The project profiles will be the following –
Demand forecasting for pharmacies and hospitals
Assessing the performance of contracts with payers and delivery networks
Creating performance scorecards for payers
Performing key driver analysis for identifying drivers of sales and access performance
The co-op will report to the market access data analytics lead and work with them to learn about the data assets, business dynamics and create analytics scripts and reports and manage their tasks in collaboration with the data governance lead.

Qualifications


A bachelor’s degree in quantitative discipline like engineering, statistics, analytics, computer science
Currently pursuing a master’s degree in quantitative discipline or a STEM focused MBA
Tools & technologies: SQL, Python (Pandas, sklearn)/R, Excel
Quantitative Skills: Regression & hypothesis testing, key driver analysis, machine learning (classification), time series analysis, forecasting algorithms, SQL analytical window functions.
Legal authorization to work in the United States, now and in the future. Please note that Vertex does not provide sponsorship for internships/co-ops or entry level roles within this part of the organization.
You must be enrolled in an advanced degree program if graduating before May 2027
You must be available to work full-time, 40 hours per week from January – July 2027


Program Details:  


Full-time, paid co-op $25.00 – 35.00 USD/hour 
Program Dates: January – July 2027 
Application Deadline: November 15th, 2026


At Vertex, we believe that when you feel your best, you can perform at your best. That’s why our US benefits and global well-being resources are designed to support you.


Free 24/7 onsite gym access and free access to group exercise classes 
Subsidized commuter benefits- transit and parking 
Provided meals—free breakfast daily! 
Career development opportunities and events, including C Suite engagement 
Social events—both intern-only and company-wide 
Location-specific perks and extras! 
Recognition of National Intern Day 


 

Our Ways of Working 

Flex Designation:  Hybrid- Boston

Flex Eligibility Status:  Hybrid: work three days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility. 

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.

FreshCut Paper provided pay range

This range is provided by FreshCut Paper. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range
$30.00/yr - $35.00/yr

We're looking for a curious, data-driven, detail-oriented student to join FreshCut Paper as a Business Insights & Analytics Co-op / Intern. This role sits at the intersection of finance, supply chain, and marketing. You'll turn sales data, channel performance, and market signals into clear insights, accurate forecasts, and recommendations the team can act on.

You'll help build and maintain forecasting models and reporting across our ecommerce, Amazon, and wholesale/retail channels. That work helps the business anticipate demand, avoid stockouts, and plan inventory with confidence. Amazon is a major focus of this role{{:}} you'll support recurring analysis of product performance, inventory health, and advertising efficiency on the channel. You'll also assist with the rollout of our new inventory management platform and help marketing connect advertising spend to revenue outcomes.

Forecasting & Growth Analytics

•     Assist in building and maintaining revenue and unit forecasts across web, Amazon, and wholesale/retail using historical sales, market trends, and other inputs

•     Help adjust forecasts for seasonality, promotions, product launches, and demand shifts, and track accuracy against actuals

•     Support marketing in connecting advertising spend and campaign performance to revenue growth across channels

•     Assist with market sizing for new markets, categories, and products, and help identify cross-channel trends and opportunities

Amazon Channel Analytics

•     Assist in analyzing product (ASIN) performance on Amazon, including sales, sessions, conversion rate, Buy Box share, rankings, and reviews, to help identify winners, underperformers, and opportunities

•     Help monitor Amazon inventory levels (FBA and inbound), weeks of cover, restock limits, and stranded or aged inventory, and flag stockout or overstock risks early

•     Support Amazon replenishment and shipment planning based on sales velocity and upcoming promotions or seasonal peaks

•     Assist marketing in analyzing Amazon advertising performance (ACoS, TACoS, ROAS) and its impact on organic sales

•     Help build and maintain recurring Amazon performance reports using Seller Central, Brand Analytics, and related tools

Inventory Analytics & New Platform Implementation

•     Help monitor real-time sales and inventory positions across channels and flag risks early to avoid stockouts

•     Assist in translating demand forecasts into inventory planning and reorder recommendations

•     Support the rollout of our new inventory management platform, including cleaning and migrating SKU and item data, validating data against NetSuite and channel sources, and testing integrations

•     Help document new processes and support teammates as they get up to speed on the platform

•     Assist in automating the flow of forecasting and inventory data to reduce manual reporting work

•     Help build reports and dashboards that keep the company informed on inventory health and key metrics




Requirements



•     Currently pursuing a graduate degree (MBA, MS in Business Analytics, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain Management, Data Science, or a related field)

•     Professional work experience preferred, ideally in analytics, demand planning, forecasting, FP&A, or supply chain; prior internship or co-op experience in these areas is a plus

•     Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, building models) and comfort working with large datasets

•     Experience with SQL, Python, Tableau, or Power BI is a plus

•     Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, multi-channel ecommerce, or NetSuite and similar ERP/inventory tools is a plus

•     Interest in inventory and supply chain planning concepts

•     Highly detail-oriented, organized, and eager to learn new systems

•     Ability to work cross-functionally with finance, supply chain, and marketing teams

•     Strong communication skills to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences




Benefits



•     Hands-on experience with real forecasting, Amazon, and inventory analytics at a fast-growing, design-driven consumer brand

•     A front-row seat to implementing a new inventory platform from the ground up

•     High visibility into cross-functional decision-making across finance, supply chain, and marketing

•     Mentorship and a collaborative, creative team culture

•     Flexible, paid, hybrid work environment
