Position Summary

LIFE SCIENCES STRATEGY CONSULTANT ROLE DESCRIPTION

Asymmetry Group is a small yet rapidly growing strategy consulting firm – included for the third year in a row on the 2025 Inc. 5000 list of fastest growing private companies in the US and named an Inc. Best Workplaces 2025 firm – that helps the world’s leading biotechnology, digital health, and medical device companies commercialize innovative therapeutics and technologies. Our clients range from early-stage Series A companies to $100B+ market cap biopharmaceutical companies. We are proud that all of the clients we serve have requested follow-on work. We cannot achieve this without an amazing team.

Asymmetry was acquired in October 2025 by the Danforth Health family of companies that collectively serve biopharmaceutical clients from inception through commercialization of products via a broad set of capabilities and offerings.

We are seeking a full-time experienced Consultant to join our team to contribute to client projects and play a key role in shaping our firm’s future through internal initiatives. Depending on the day, week, or month, you might be working on the launch of a new rare disease product, developing a commercial plan to support a breakthrough Phase 3 asset, running client workshops, or engaging with the leadership team of a digital health company on how to differentiate their offer in the market. We’re looking for a highly motivated, proactive doer who is experienced in life sciences strategy consulting. There will be some travel – but it’s generally limited.

What can we offer you?


Meaningful Work: We deliver high-quality, pragmatic work to the most innovative healthcare companies out there – we work for clients and on projects that we are passionate about, and that we believe have the potential to bring real advances to healthcare
Strong Team & Culture: We foster a small, collegial organization that takes the best characteristics of consulting to create a supportive culture – we work hard, but we believe in integrating work/life in the way that matters most to our individual employees. Our incredible team is the backbone of what we do, and we are committed to maintaining a culture that supports them (and you!)
Growth & Development: We strive to individualize team member development. All team members have different strengths and skill sets; we tailor career progression based on your specific interests and needs, and we recognize and promote on true merit rather than anchor to fixed time periods
Strong Compensation: We offer industry-competitive salary and bonus, 401k, healthcare / dental / vision LTD/AD&D, and a flexible time-off policy
Broad Capabilities: As part of Danforth Health, we have access to an incredibly broad and deep set of capabilities that enable us to better serve our clients across their varied needs


Role Duties & Responsibilities

Your day-to-day will involve a wide range of activities, roles & responsibilities can be fluid, and success will require a willingness and agility to learn and adapt quickly. The role will naturally evolve based on firm and client needs, as well as your own individual capabilities. However, the following are representative areas where the Consultant will play a key role:


Direct support of strategic client engagements, potentially including: research & analysis; thought partnership internally and with the client; PowerPoint document creation and storytelling; workshop facilitation; market assessments; forecast development; etc.
Leading full workstreams within a project (e.g., developing a launch plan, designing the customer experience for a new product, developing a customer segmentation, etc.)
Managing and developing Analysts / Sr Analysts on project workstreams, and communicating clearly and proactively with peers and Managers
Supporting business development activities, including company / product research, proposal development, methodology creation, etc.
Serving as a Development Manager to more junior members of the firm
Proactive recognition of industry trends, and their impact on our clients and our business
Firm marketing, including blog posts, thought leadership and coordination of partner and industry events


Essential Qualifications


3-4 years professional experience in life sciences strategy consulting
Experienced with Microsoft Office suite, primarily PowerPoint, Word, and Excel, as well as Smartsheet
Must be able to create a clear, logical “narrative” and share it through strong storytelling slides in PPT
Self-starter, curious, proactive, entrepreneurial mindset, with a healthy dose of agility
Ability to distill complex analyses and topics into structured, focused and simple takeaways
Strong oral and written communication skills
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Comfort with, and success in, managing and developing analysts
Exemplify the Asymmetry behaviors of showing up professionally, consistently demonstrating a growth mindset, assuming good intent of others, and making those around you better
Able to travel for client meetings locally, nationally and internationally
Undergrad degree in a relevant discipline – business, biology, economics, etc.
US work authorization to work at Asymmetry Group without additional or future sponsorship


Preferred Qualifications


Advanced degree in a relevant discipline – Masters or Ph.D.
Desire for hybrid work environment (our team is in-office Tuesday-Thursday, with optional work-from-home on Monday and Friday, subject to client commitments)
Candidates local to the Boston, New York, or Philadelphia areas (primary office is in Newton, MA; smaller offices in midtown Manhattan and the greater Philadelphia area)


Compensation

The annualized salary range for this role is between $125,000 – $170,000, plus an incentive bonus. The actual base pay offered may vary based on several factors including role-related qualifications such as skills, knowledge, total experience, and education. The role may also be eligible for other forms of compensation such as health benefits, 401k, etc.

Application Instructions: please send a resume/CV and a brief explanation of your interest in this role to careers@asymmetrygroup.com while modelling the following file-naming conventions: Name – FileType (e.g., Resume or Cover Letter) – Position. Additionally, please note the role title in the subject line of your email.

Company Overview

Asymmetry Group is a boutique life science advisory firm founded to help innovative healthcare companies drive extraordinary growth. We do this by providing services including corporate and portfolio strategy, product / asset strategy, product launch support and organizational transformation initiatives for our biotech, medical device and diagnostic, and life science clients. Our name, Asymmetry Group, is derived from the notion that asymmetric insights lead to stronger strategic decisions. Our founder and leadership have deep experience in client advisory work, as well as direct industry experience within many life science companies. More details about the type of work we do can be found on our website, www.asymmetrygroup.com.

All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other category protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. U.S. work authorization is required.

Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

The Consultant, Population Health & Well-Being performs client-facing and internal work to support health and welfare, population health and well-being consulting initiatives.

This position sits within our Population Health & Well-Being team, a specialized part of Brown & Brown’s Employee Benefits Consulting line of business.

The Consultant, Population Health & Well-Being will be assigned to client teams and/or consulting projects and will work collaboratively with other consulting teammates across a broad range of employee benefits, health and well-being initiatives.

Core Responsibilities


Technical Knowledge: Demonstrate reasonable knowledge of a broad spectrum of health and well-being trends, employer strategies, vendor solutions, emerging practices, and innovative approaches to inform client recommendations and support strategic decision-making.
Project Management: Develop and update project management logs while keeping all stakeholders informed on project status. Proactively supporting the advancement of project milestones and closure of open items.
Data Analysis: Conducting data analysis to support client deliverables and internal initiatives – practical execution of this function entails sending out data requests, reviewing data for accuracy, analyzing data, developing summary of findings and presenting data insights to internal consulting team for review, before client delivery.
Benchmarking: Perform benchmarking analysis of population health and well-being tactics and strategies of interest to our clients leveraging internal and external data sources.
Vendor Management: Perform a broad spectrum of consulting tasks related to vendor management – including but not limited to; attending vendor calls, requesting and negotiating vendor fee renewals, administering Request for Proposals (RFPs), reconciling performance guarantees, and advocating on behalf of clients.
Proper Documentation: Accurate notetaking during internal and client-facing meetings with report-out of key discussion items and next steps. The role also entails proper documentation and filing of relevant data and information used for client-facing and internal initiatives.
Presentation Development: Create compelling, high-quality PowerPoint presentations that clearly communicate insights and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders. Ability to transform complex data into visually engaging, easy-to-understand narratives.
Cross-Functional Teamwork and Collaboration: Work closely with internal consulting teams, client stakeholders, and external vendors to ensure alignment and successful execution of health and well-being strategies.


Skills Needed


Bachelor’s degree in relevant field e.g. Health Administration, Business, Public Health, etc.

Strong client facing and communication skills
Strong analytical and financial analysis skills
Proficient with MS Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

Health Benefits: Medical/Rx, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance
Financial Benefits: ESPP; 401k; Student Loan Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement

Beyond Benefits: Paid Time Off, Holidays, Preferred Partner Discounts and more.

Job Requisition ID #

26WD100617

Position Overview

Autodesk is shaping the future of the design and make industries by helping our customers navigate a rapidly evolving AI-driven landscape. Supporting our Autodesk AI initiatives, you will help us understand how AI and new business models are reshaping the competitive landscape across Manufacturing, AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Operations), and Media and Entertainment.

This is an individual contributor role on a team with deep business, industry, and technical experience. A successful candidate builds with AI by default, not as a tool added on top.

The way competitive intelligence gets done is changing faster than most business functions can adapt. We’re hiring for that gap. You will spend as much time building the systems that produce our intelligence as you will producing it.

Location: We support hybrid work, and you work near our Portland, Oregon, or San Francisco, California offices.

Responsibilities


Build and maintain the automated systems that produce our intelligence, including source monitoring and refresh cadences
Find the parts of our process that shouldn’t be manual anymore and fix them without waiting for permission
Track how AI is changing our markets, following competitors, startups, funding, product releases, partnerships, research, talent movement, and regulatory shifts
Work directly with business functions, product management, engineering, and technical benchmarking to define target markets, map competitive landscapes, size opportunities, identify gaps, and test market and commercial assumptions against what is actually buildable
Synthesize qualitative and quantitative information into clear points of view, challenging assumptions, reconciling conflicting perspectives, and connecting findings to broader implications for Autodesk
You have a working sense of what is hard and what is easy to build with AI right now, and you can form a reasonable hypothesis about how a competitor pulled something off
Take the lead on coordinating research and intelligence projects as needed, bringing structure to ambiguous questions, facilitating discussions, managing contributors and timelines, keeping teams on track, and ensuring conclusions are captured in clear final deliverables
Produce recurring competitive intelligence and fast-turn analysis for leaders, translating complex market and technical developments into concise, executive-ready briefs, presentations, and market maps, including for C-suite
Keep the competitive picture available to teams on demand
Bring us tools, methods, and ideas before we know to ask. Push when you think we’re doing something the slow way
Occasional travel to industry events and internal meetings


Minimum Qualifications


You’ve built workflows, agents, or pipelines that run without you. Bring one to the interview and walk us through the choices you made
Strong analytical judgment and the ability to turn incomplete or fragmented information into a defensible point of view
You start things. The work you’re proudest of is probably something nobody assigned you
5+ years of experience in one or more of the following, or a combination: competitive intelligence, market research, business intelligence, strategy, consulting, product management, software or data engineering
Know where automated output needs a human check, and build that check into the system
Ability to lead projects or significant workstreams involving multiple stakeholders and deadlines
Data storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex information clear to senior stakeholders
Ability to collaborate on analytical work, including contributing to projects led by others and bringing different perspectives into a coherent output
Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, data science, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience


Preferred Qualifications


Demonstrated interest in physical AI across Autodesk industries: Manufacturing, AECO, or Media and Entertainment
You can read a competitor’s model release or data position and say what it means for their roadmap and their cost structure
Experience with customer discovery, market validation, go-to-market analysis, or business case development
Experience with Python, SQL, or similar, at the level of getting something working rather than shipping production code
Familiarity with incumbent market data sources such as PitchBook, CB Insights, Crunchbase, or similar platforms
Experience with Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical tools
MBA or equivalent business experience


Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Canada based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $78,000 and $114,400. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification

This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.

Introduction

At IBM Research, we are the innovation engine of IBM. Exploring what’s next in computing and shaping the technologies the world will rely on tomorrow. From advancing AI and hybrid cloud to pioneering practical quantum computing, we anticipate challenges and unlock new opportunities for clients, partners, and society. Working in Research means joining a team that accelerates discovery at the intersection of high-performance computing, AI, quantum, and cloud. You’ll collaborate with leading scientists, engineers, and visionaries to push boundaries and turn ideas into reality. With a culture built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration, IBM Research offers the opportunity to grow your career while contributing to breakthroughs that transform industries and change the world.

Your Role And Responsibilities

Within IBM Quantum, the Adoption Team is an elite team serving our partners as they research quantum computing solutions for their most pressing business challenges. We keep our partners up to date with the latest technical advances, and make sure they are empowered to use our software and services. As a data scientist intern, you will be supporting our data and analytics mission to drive reporting on and insights into the IBM Quantum partners and community members and your work will enable the team to make data-driven decisions. Focus areas will include adoption and impact of IBM Quantum hardware, software, learning and outreach content, and events. As a data scientist intern, your key stakeholders will be client/community-facing teams at IBM Quantum. In addition, you will interface across many individuals and parties at partner institutions and within IBM, including technical teams within IBM Quantum, product, marketing, and business development teams. You will support end-to-end workstreams, such as the building of new analytics resources and performing of advanced (predictive) data analysis. Successful attributes to thrive in this role are: Creative in framing and solving complex problems Self-starter Agile in navigating a complex organization and in stakeholder management Organized, with exceptional project management skills Quick learner with an independent growth mindset Able to absorb new technical concepts quickly and thoroughly Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly Enthusiasm about quantum computing and data science.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Pursuing a masters or PhD degree in data science or other quantitative field such as mathematics, computer science, statistics or physics.
Proficiency with SQL and experience working with relational databases.
Proficiency with Python and libraries commonly used for data analysis (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, matplotlib, Seaborn, etc.).
Knowledge of common machine learning algorithms and frameworks: linear regression, decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting (e.g., XGBoost, LightGBM), neural networks, and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch Experience building dashboards with one or more data visualization tools (experience with Metabase and/or Amplitude a plus)


Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Demonstrated ability to communicate project insights and findings and propose actionable next steps.

Explore different industries. Learn new skills. Connect with our diverse teams of professionals to gain insight into the career you envision. Your Career Starts with You.

Experience the Transformative Power of Withum Plus You - that’s the Power in the Plus!

Job Description

Withum's Valuation Consulting Services team assists companies with business valuations, M&A transactions, financial reporting, economic analysis, fairness opinions, risk management, and other strategic advisory services. As our advisory practice continues to expand, including new outsourced accounting and finance solutions, we are seeking high-performing students interested in valuation, corporate finance, and transaction advisory.

Internship Details

Dates: January 25th,2027 to April 16th, 2027 with possibility of extension

Location: Boston Seaport, Rochester or Philadelphia

Schedule: 40 hours per week, in-person. Interns are expected to work during core business hours.

Key Responsibilities


Assist in the preparation of business valuation analyses for mergers and acquisitions, financial reporting, tax, and advisory purposes.
Support valuation engagements involving privately held companies, intangible assets, and transaction-related analyses.
Complete financial statement and operating data analysis using Excel-based valuation models.
Conduct industry, market, economic, and company-specific research.
Assist with financial modeling, data analysis, and valuation assessments.
Participate in client meetings and internal discussions related to valuation and advisory engagements.
Collaborate with professionals across Valuation Consulting, Transaction Advisory, and Outsourced Accounting Advisory teams.
Prepare sections of valuation reports, presentations, and client deliverables.
Participate in training sessions, professional development programs, and networking opportunities.
Support business development initiatives and relationship-building activities.


Qualifications


Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Quantitative Finance, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Economics, Financial Engineering, Accounting, Business Analytics, or a related discipline. MSA, Master of Finance, MBA, and similar graduate programs are encouraged to apply.
Minimum 3.7 GPA required.
Previous internship or relevant experience in valuation, investment banking, transaction advisory, corporate finance, consulting, or financial services preferred.
Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Understanding of financial statements, valuation methodologies, and financial modeling.
Excellent communication, networking, and presentation skills with the ability to excel in client-facing environments.
Demonstrated leadership, initiative, and professional presence through academic, extracurricular, or work experience.
Candidates should be prepared to complete a finance and valuation case study during the interview process.


Why Withum?

Withum is a firm built on the principle that the only limits to your growth are the ones you set for yourself. Our culture is centered around an expansion mindset both in terms of the firm's growth and the personal development of every team member. At Withum, opportunities for advancement and success are directly tied to initiative, ambition, and contributions.

Interns are active contributors to client engagements and gain meaningful exposure to valuation, M&A, corporate finance, and advisory services while working alongside experienced professionals. If you're interested in building a career in valuation and transaction advisory, we encourage you to apply.

The compensation for this position ranges from $25 to $30 an hour. Final offer amounts are based on multiple factors such as the specific role, hiring location, as well as the individual’s skills, experience and qualifications. Now we’re looking for more thinkers, doers, builders, and makers to join us. People who’ll bring new perspectives, solve tough problems, and thrive as part of a team.

If that’s you and this role fits, we want to hear from you.

Join the power movement as an AI & Infrastructure Engineering Intern

We are looking for a talented AI & Infrastructure Engineering Intern to join our team! CFS interns are highly valued within the organization and placed into meaningful and challenging roles.

Program Details:


26 week internship
40-50 hours per week with set hourly salary based on year in school
Opportunity on site in Devens, MA. If an intern is going to be on site, you will be responsible for your own transportation and housing
Specific project assignments and required technical skillset will vary based on the team’s existing need
Opportunities available for currently enrolled college students in all levels of schooling from bachelor’s degree to PhD
Interns must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer



What you'll do:


Serve as first-line support for employees using AI tools:
Help people build and version their own applications
Follow repo and file-management best practices
Get unstuck on the technical side of AI implementation

Handle AI tooling onboarding:
Process license requests through the Service Catalog
Set up GitHub and AI tool access
Guide teams through creating and publishing marketplace plugins

Develop and maintain internal AI applications:
Implement scoped features and write automated tests
Turn recurring user questions into training content and company documentation

Meet with teams across the business to document current AI usage, identify aspirational use cases and bespoke problems, and coach interested individuals toward becoming self-sufficient AI developers



What we’re looking for:


Python backend development
Git/GitHub workflows: branching, pull requests, code review, etc
Experience building with AI coding tools, including configuring project rules, skills, or custom agents
Working with LLM APIs: tool use, structured outputs, prompt and context management
Building or deploying an MCP server
Agent frameworks and observability or evaluation tooling
RAG fundamentals: embeddings, vector stores
Docker and Linux basics
Authentication concepts: SSO, role-based access
Strong communication - the intern will spend time meeting with non-technical teams
Security and data-handling awareness - the role touches SSO, access provisioning, and internal data



Must-have Requirements:


Willingness to travel or work required nights/weekends/on-call occasionally
Perform activities such as typing, standing, or sitting for extended periods of time
Dedication to safety to mitigate industrial hazards that may include heat, cold, noise, fumes, strong magnets, lead (Pb), high voltage, and cryogenics



At CFS, we excel in fast-paced environments, driven by our values of integrity, execution, impact, and self-critique. As we grow, we’re eager to bring on mission-driven folks who offer diverse perspectives and fresh ways to tackle challenges.

Job Description

The Future Talent Program features internships that last 10-12 weeks and will include one or more projects. These opportunities can provide you with great development and a chance to see if we are the right company for your long-term goals.

The Biostatistics and Research Decision Sciences (BARDS) Epidemiology and RWE Capabilities & Analytics is seeking 2027 summer interns.

Primary responsibilities may include but are not limited to the following:


Summarizing background information of a specific topic via targeted literature review
Conducting data analysis in real-world health data sources to understand data quality, disease identification or treatment patterns, develop and validate prediction models
Summarizing and interpreting study results
Contributing to protocol development and manuscript writing
Contributing to development and update of visualization tools (e.g., dashboard, geospatial visuals) of real-world data
Contributing to development of materials to understand artificial intelligence and machine learning methods
Communicating findings to an internal or external audience


The interns will have the opportunity to present their research work in internal or external professional forums or meetings. In addition, the interns will attend departmental and project team meetings to gain a broad perspective on the application of epidemiology and statistical method in the pharmaceutical industry. We are seeking intern candidates with strong academic performance, communication skills, spirit of teamwork, and the ability to work in a multi-functional environment.

Locations: West Point, PA; Upper Gwynedd, PA; Rahway, NJ, Boston, MA

Minimum Education Requirements


Candidates must be a currently enrolled graduate student pursuing a PhD degree in epidemiology, biostatistics, public health, data science, biomedical informatics, or other closely related field; Or a currently enrolled graduate student pursuing a PharmD degree with relevant training in epidemiology
Candidates will have completed at least 2 semesters of graduate work towards a PhD degree in epidemiology, biostatistics, public health, data Science, biomedical Informatics, or other closely related field by May 30, 2027; or towards a PharmD degree with relevant training in epidemiology by May 30, 2027.


Required Experience And Skills


Candidates must be able to commit to full-time employment for 10 - 12 weeks beginning in May or June 2027.
Candidates must be scheduled to return to school in Fall 2027, unless the internship is a requirement for their degree.
Candidates must have effective oral and written communication skills.


Preferred Experience And Skills


Candidates should have prior literature review (systematic/target) experience, have a good understanding of real-world data and real-world databases and have a good knowledge of SAS, SQL, R, or Python.
Students with an interest in genetics/biomarkers, geospatial analysis, policy, or patient-reported outcomes/clinical outcomes assessments (PROs/COAs), data science, model development, artificial intelligence/machine learning are encouraged to apply.


Please note that this position may be closed before the posted end date or may remain open longer, at the discretion of the company.

Currently pursuing or recently graduated with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field.
Strong foundational knowledge of SQL (joining tables, writing queries).
Familiarity with programming languages like Python or R for data manipulation (pandas, numpy).
Basic experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables).
Strong problem-solving abilities and a highly analytical mindset.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills to present complex data findings simply.
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a fast-paced team.
High attention to detail and data integrity.


Compensation And Benefits

Hourly Pay Range: $26.00 to $37.00 per hour. This range is a good faith estimate of the expected salary range for this position, based on a wide range of factors including qualifications, experience and training, operational and business needs and other considerations permitted by law. The application period for the intern/co-op position is estimated to be through the end of November 2026; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

MKS is an equal opportunity employer, including disability, veteran status and all categories protected by law. Please review our EOE statements for additional details.

Job Title: 2027 Spring Co-op Process and CMC Data Science


Grade: Co-op
Location: Waltham, MA
Duration: 6 months


About The Job

Looking to launch your career at the cutting edge of healthcare? Join Sanofi for a chance to develop with mentoring and guidance from inspirational leaders while helping to make an impact on the lives of countless people worldwide. We are seeking a highly motivated Spring Co-op to join our Process and CMC Data Science team.

We are an innovative global healthcare company that helps the world stay ahead of infectious diseases by delivering more than 500 million vaccine doses a year. Across different countries, our talented teams are exploring new technologies to protect people and promote healthy communities. We chase the miracles of science every single day, pursuing Progress to make a real impact on millions of patients around the world.

The Co-op position is located in the Data and Computational Science (DCS) department within Sanofi's mRNA Center of Excellence (mRNA CoE). In this role you will develop first-principle, machine-learning (ML), and hybrid models for critical drug-substance unit operations—including In-Vitro Transcription (IVT), Tangential Flow Filtration (TFF), and Chromatography—to accelerate mRNA-based process development.

You will gain hands-on experience with mRNA technology and drug-substance manufacturing operations while applying advanced modeling techniques. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge biopharmaceutical research at the intersection of data science and process engineering.

Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams.

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities


Develop and validate first-principle, ML, and hybrid models for drug-substance unit operations such as IVT, TFF, and Chromatography in collaboration with your supervisor and cross-functional team members.
Investigate the impact of process parameters on critical quality attributes (CQAs) and quantify associated uncertainties using statistical and computational methods.
Design and execute Design of Experiments (DoE) for model structure selection, parameter estimation, and process optimization.
Analyze experimental and simulation data to generate actionable insights that inform process development decisions.
Document modeling workflows, results, and recommendations in clear technical reports and presentations.


About You

Basic Qualifications:


Pursuing a Master's por PhD in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry, Data Science, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Analytical Chemistry, Physics, Software Engineering or a related quantitative field at an accredited college or university.
Must be permanently authorized to work in the U.S. and not require sponsorship of an employment visa (e.g., H-1B or green card) at the time of application or in the future. Students currently on CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT usually require future sponsorship for long term employment and do not meet the Internal requirements for this program unless eligible for an alternative long-term status that does not require company sponsorship.
Must be enrolled in an accredited college or university throughout the duration of the co-op/internship.
Must be able to relocate to the office location and work 40hrs/week, Monday to Friday for the full duration of the co-op/internship.


Preferred Qualifications


Foundational knowledge of mRNA technology or biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
Experience developing physics-informed or physics-constrained ML, first-principle, or hybrid dynamic models for physical or biological systems.
Proficiency in one or more modeling and programming tools: Python (must-have) (BOTorch, PYOMO), MATLAB (nice to have), Julia, or gPROMS (nice to have).
Nice to have: First-principle models, machine-learning, chromatography optimization, ML models para IVT, purification, chromatography processes
Familiarity with Design of Experiments (DoE), uncertainty quantification, and Bayesian optimization.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present technical results to diverse audiences.
Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale.


Why Choose Us


Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future focused team.
Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you.
Learn from inspiring mentors and collaborative teams while contributing to real projects that shape the future of healthcare.
Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve


Compensation

The salary range for this position is $35.00-$60.00 hourly. All compensation will be determined commensurate with demonstrated experience.

Job Description

Kickstart Your Career at Vertex! 

Are you ready to make a real impact? At Vertex, our mission is to tackle serious diseases and to change lives, for the better, for the future. Our aim is to give you the skills, insights, and career guidance to be an important part of that future; to turn your potential into progression. As a Vertex intern or co-op, you’ll work on meaningful projects, collaborate with talented teams, and learn from industry leaders. We’re passionate about innovation, inclusion, and supporting your growth—inside and outside the lab. 

Why Vertex? 


Real Projects: You’ll work on assignments that make a real impact, not just busy work. 
Mentorship & Networking: Connect with leaders and peers who want to see you succeed through professional networks, connections, and collaborations that will shape your longer-term career. 
Flexible & Supportive: We offer flexible work options with Flex @ Vertex and prioritize your wellbeing. 
Inclusive Culture: Collaboration and inclusion are embedded in everything we do. 
Career Launchpad: Build skills, explore career paths, and get guidance for your future career. 


Your Impact

The Vertex Commercial Analytics, Market Access Co-Op is a 6-month experiential training program for students currently working towards an undergraduate or advanced degree in Engineering, Statistics, Analytics, STEM, or other related fields. If you are passionate, collaborative, and growth-minded, a co-op at Vertex will help you gain meaningful experience in our US Market Access functional areas and serve as a launchpad for your career.

The application deadline for this co-op is November 15th. Please note that Vertex reviews applications on a rolling basis and reserves the right to close this job posting prior to the listed deadline. Applicants can expect to receive an update about their application before or shortly after the application deadline.

Ready to apply? Submit your application and let’s turn possibilities into reality! 

 What you will be doing: 

US Market Access analytics team functions as an analytics center of excellence for the market access strategy, trade & distribution, revenue forecasting and pricing teams. The analytics team supports use cases that help the different commercial business units ensure that patients with a script for Vertex products have access to the products through their health plans, pharmacies and sites-of-care.

The co-op commercial analytics will work with the US market access analytics team to work on forecasting and regression use cases that can help identify key drivers and barriers towards patient access for our pain and cystic fibrosis portfolio.

Key Responsibilities


The co-op commercial analytics will work on several small initiatives each with a timeline of 3-4 weeks, the initial few weeks will be spent in training around US pharma and market access dynamics. The project profiles will be the following –
Demand forecasting for pharmacies and hospitals
Assessing the performance of contracts with payers and delivery networks
Creating performance scorecards for payers
Performing key driver analysis for identifying drivers of sales and access performance
The co-op will report to the market access data analytics lead and work with them to learn about the data assets, business dynamics and create analytics scripts and reports and manage their tasks in collaboration with the data governance lead.

Qualifications


A bachelor’s degree in quantitative discipline like engineering, statistics, analytics, computer science
Currently pursuing a master’s degree in quantitative discipline or a STEM focused MBA
Tools & technologies: SQL, Python (Pandas, sklearn)/R, Excel
Quantitative Skills: Regression & hypothesis testing, key driver analysis, machine learning (classification), time series analysis, forecasting algorithms, SQL analytical window functions.
Legal authorization to work in the United States, now and in the future. Please note that Vertex does not provide sponsorship for internships/co-ops or entry level roles within this part of the organization.
You must be enrolled in an advanced degree program if graduating before May 2027
You must be available to work full-time, 40 hours per week from January – July 2027


Program Details:  


Full-time, paid co-op $25.00 – 35.00 USD/hour 
Program Dates: January – July 2027 
Application Deadline: November 15th, 2026


At Vertex, we believe that when you feel your best, you can perform at your best. That’s why our US benefits and global well-being resources are designed to support you.


Free 24/7 onsite gym access and free access to group exercise classes 
Subsidized commuter benefits- transit and parking 
Provided meals—free breakfast daily! 
Career development opportunities and events, including C Suite engagement 
Social events—both intern-only and company-wide 
Location-specific perks and extras! 
Recognition of National Intern Day 


 

Our Ways of Working 

Flex Designation:  Hybrid- Boston

Flex Eligibility Status:  Hybrid: work three days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility. 

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.  

This job posting is for a temporary role with a third-party agency partner that provides services to Vertex.  The individual selected for this role will be offered the role as an employee of that third-party agency; compensation, medical benefits, fringe benefits and other terms and conditions of employment shall be presented by the third-party agency upon offer. 

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

Pay Range

$0 - $0

Disclosure Statement

The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.

Company Information

Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation.

Vertex is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Vertex is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. Vertex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact Talent Acquisition at ApplicationAssistance@vrtx.com

We're looking for a curious, data-driven, detail-oriented student to join FreshCut Paper as a Business Insights & Analytics Co-op / Intern. This role sits at the intersection of finance, supply chain, and marketing. You'll turn sales data, channel performance, and market signals into clear insights, accurate forecasts, and recommendations the team can act on.

You'll help build and maintain forecasting models and reporting across our ecommerce, Amazon, and wholesale/retail channels. That work helps the business anticipate demand, avoid stockouts, and plan inventory with confidence. Amazon is a major focus of this role{{:}} you'll support recurring analysis of product performance, inventory health, and advertising efficiency on the channel. You'll also assist with the rollout of our new inventory management platform and help marketing connect advertising spend to revenue outcomes.

Forecasting & Growth Analytics

•     Assist in building and maintaining revenue and unit forecasts across web, Amazon, and wholesale/retail using historical sales, market trends, and other inputs

•     Help adjust forecasts for seasonality, promotions, product launches, and demand shifts, and track accuracy against actuals

•     Support marketing in connecting advertising spend and campaign performance to revenue growth across channels

•     Assist with market sizing for new markets, categories, and products, and help identify cross-channel trends and opportunities

Amazon Channel Analytics

•     Assist in analyzing product (ASIN) performance on Amazon, including sales, sessions, conversion rate, Buy Box share, rankings, and reviews, to help identify winners, underperformers, and opportunities

•     Help monitor Amazon inventory levels (FBA and inbound), weeks of cover, restock limits, and stranded or aged inventory, and flag stockout or overstock risks early

•     Support Amazon replenishment and shipment planning based on sales velocity and upcoming promotions or seasonal peaks

•     Assist marketing in analyzing Amazon advertising performance (ACoS, TACoS, ROAS) and its impact on organic sales

•     Help build and maintain recurring Amazon performance reports using Seller Central, Brand Analytics, and related tools

Inventory Analytics & New Platform Implementation

•     Help monitor real-time sales and inventory positions across channels and flag risks early to avoid stockouts

•     Assist in translating demand forecasts into inventory planning and reorder recommendations

•     Support the rollout of our new inventory management platform, including cleaning and migrating SKU and item data, validating data against NetSuite and channel sources, and testing integrations

•     Help document new processes and support teammates as they get up to speed on the platform

•     Assist in automating the flow of forecasting and inventory data to reduce manual reporting work

•     Help build reports and dashboards that keep the company informed on inventory health and key metrics




Requirements

Job Description

Kickstart Your Career at Vertex! 

Are you ready to make a real impact? At Vertex, our mission is to tackle serious diseases and to change lives, for the better, for the future. Our aim is to give you the skills, insights, and career guidance to be an important part of that future; to turn your potential into progression. As a Vertex intern or co-op, you’ll work on meaningful projects, collaborate with talented teams, and learn from industry leaders. We’re passionate about innovation, inclusion, and supporting your growth—inside and outside the lab. 

Why Vertex? 


Real Projects: You’ll work on assignments that make a real impact, not just busy work. 
Mentorship & Networking: Connect with leaders and peers who want to see you succeed through professional networks, connections, and collaborations that will shape your longer-term career. 
Flexible & Supportive: We offer flexible work options with Flex @ Vertex and prioritize your wellbeing. 
Inclusive Culture: Collaboration and inclusion are embedded in everything we do. 
Career Launchpad: Build skills, explore career paths, and get guidance for your future career. 


Your Impact

The Vertex Commercial Analytics Co-Op is a 6-month experiential training program for students currently working towards an advanced degree in Data Analytics, Business, Statistics or other related fields. If you are passionate, collaborative, and growth-minded, a co-op at Vertex will help you gain meaningful experience in our Commercial functional areas and serve as a launchpad for your career.

The application deadline for this co-op is November 15th. Please note that Vertex reviews applications on a rolling basis and reserves the right to close this job posting prior to the listed deadline. Applicants can expect to receive an update about their application before or shortly after the application deadline.

Ready to apply? Submit your application and let’s turn possibilities into reality! 

 What you will be doing: 

The Commercial Analytics Intern will support the Commercial Analytics team in preparation for a rare disease launch. This project-oriented internship will provide educational exposure to commercial analytics work and opportunities to contribute to defined launch-related analyses, deliverables, and planning activities.

Key Responsibilities


Support project-oriented commercial analytics assignments related to rare disease launch preparation.
Assist with analysis, organization, and communication of commercial data and insights that support launch planning.
Contribute to defined project deliverables and complete work in accordance with assigned timelines.
Participate in interactions with relevant internal stakeholders to support project execution and alignment.
Develop and present summaries of analyses, findings, and recommendations as appropriate.
Potential assignments may include supporting launch-related market, customer, performance, or business analyses, depending on the team’s identified priorities.


Qualifications


Currently pursuing a degree at the undergraduate or graduate level in Statistics, Data Analytics, Business or a related field.
Demonstrated interest in commercial analytics and/or rare disease commercial work.
Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
Ability to work on defined projects, manage deliverables, and meet assigned timelines.
Legal authorization to work in the United States, now and in the future. Please note that Vertex does not provide sponsorship for internships/co-ops or entry level roles within this part of the organization.
You must be enrolled in an advanced degree program if graduating before May 2027
You must be available to work full-time, 40 hours per week from January – July 2027


Program Details:  


Full-time, paid co-op $25.00 – 35.00 USD/hour 
Program Dates: January – July 2027 
Application Deadline: November 15th, 2026


At Vertex, we believe that when you feel your best, you can perform at your best. That’s why our US benefits and global well-being resources are designed to support you.


Free 24/7 onsite gym access and free access to group exercise classes 
Subsidized commuter benefits- transit and parking 
Provided meals—free breakfast daily! 
Career development opportunities and events, including C Suite engagement 
Social events—both intern-only and company-wide 
Location-specific perks and extras! 
Recognition of National Intern Day 


 

Our Ways of Working 

Flex Designation:  Hybrid - Boston

Flex Eligibility Status:  Hybrid: work three days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility. 

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.  

This job posting is for a temporary role with a third-party agency partner that provides services to Vertex.  The individual selected for this role will be offered the role as an employee of that third-party agency; compensation, medical benefits, fringe benefits and other terms and conditions of employment shall be presented by the third-party agency upon offer. 

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

Pay Range

$0 - $0

Disclosure Statement

The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.

Company Information

Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation.

Vertex is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Vertex is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. Vertex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact Talent Acquisition at ApplicationAssistance@vrtx.com

Job Overview:

Winter 2027 Co-op - Supply Planning & Analytics

As a Winter 2027 Co-op - Supply Planning & Analytics at Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP), you will lead a high-impact strategic initiative to transition packaging across the Coffee Beverage portfolio. This project will support regulatory compliance requirements while minimizing inventory risk and obsolescence exposure throughout the transition lifecycle. You will gain hands-on experience in supply chain planning, analytics, project management, inventory management, and cross-functional leadership while working closely with Commercial, Brand, Demand Planning, Finished Goods Planning, Raw Material Planning, Supply Chain Initiatives, and senior leadership teams.

Shift/Schedule:


The KDP 2027 Winter Co-op Program runs from January 4th - May 21st, 2027
Location: Burlington, MA
Full-time; 40 hours per week
Monday-Friday
8:00am until 5:00pm
Hybrid (3 Days In Office/Week)



As a Supply Planning & Analytics Co-op you will:


Develop reporting and dashboards to track inventory depletion, packaging conversion status & project milestones leveraging large datasets
Create visibility tools & project governance that support transition tracking enabling leadership decision-making and cross-functional alignment
Facilitate regular project meetings & follow up actions to ensure stakeholders remain aligned on timelines, risks, inventory impacts & transition readiness; escalating issues when required
Develop mitigation strategies to reduce excess inventory & financial exposure throughout the transition process



Elements of the KDP 2027 Co-op Program include:


Engaging and partnering on innovative projects to gain experience in a fast paced, cross functional team environment
Receive mentor support for your professional development
Participate in meet & greets and lunch & learns with KDP executives and other organization leaders
Receive professional development training such as networking, professional skills development and presenting
Complete a project from start to finish and present it and your takeaways to your team, department, and senior leaders to highlight your project work and impact on the business



Total Rewards:


$31/hr
Paid bi-weekly
$5,000 sign-on bonus, paid within first 30 days of employment



Requirements:


Undergraduate currently enrolled in a full time academic program from an accredited college or university, majoring in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Operations Management, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to work cross-functionally, be independently driven & adapt to changes
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize requests, and meet deadlines
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel
Preferred:
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other visualization tools
Experience with project management methodologies
Knowledge of supply chain, inventory management, or operations planning concepts
Experience working with large datasets


Please Note: You must be work authorized in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 (student) visa holders who require sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full-time basis.

 

We incorporate HireVue, an automated interview tool, into our campus recruitment process. Please visit this link to learn more about HireVue and how to prepare. *We recommend checking with your campus career center for additional preparation resources such as InterviewStream, Big Interview and more.

Company Overview:

Keurig Dr Pepper (Nasdaq: KDP) is a leading beverage company with more than 150 owned, licensed and partner brands that meet a wide range of needs and occasions. Our North American refreshment beverage business holds leadership positions across carbonated soft drinks, water, juice and mixers with a portfolio of iconic brands such as Dr Pepper®, Canada Dry®, Mott’s®, A&W®, Peñafiel®, GHOST®, 7UP®, Snapple®, Clamato® and Core Hydration®. Our global coffee business spans more than 100 markets and includes the leading Keurig® single‑serve brewing system in the U.S. and Canada, along with powerhouse brands such as Peet’s, L’OR and Jacobs, and other regional coffee leaders. Our more than 50,000 employees aim to enhance the experience of every beverage and coffee occasion while making a positive impact for people, communities and the planet.

We strive to be an employer of choice, providing a culture and opportunities that empower our team to grow and develop. We offer robust benefits to support your health and wellness as well as your personal and financial well-being. We also provide employee programs designed to enhance your professional growth and development, while ensuring you feel valued, inspired and appreciated at work.

Whatever your area of expertise, at KDP you can be a part of a team that’s proud of its brands, partnerships, innovation and growth. Will you join us?

Keurig Dr Pepper is an equal opportunity employer and recruits qualified applicants and advances in employment its employees without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, disability or association with a person with a disability, medical condition, genetic information, ethnic or national origin, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

KDP uses artificial intelligence to assist with initial resume screening and candidate matching. This technology helps us efficiently identify candidates whose qualifications align with our open roles. AI does not make hiring decisions; all decisions throughout the hiring process are made by talent acquisition team members. If you prefer not to have your application processed using artificial intelligence, you may opt out by emailing your resume and qualifications directly to kdpjobs@kdrp.com in lieu of clicking Apply. In order for your application to be considered and opted out of AI, you must include the words "AI Opt-Out" and either job title and location or Job ID # in the email subject line in your email application.
